asr.full_text: BCCAY CRYPTO-CURRENCY Hey guys thanks for joining us here at Alphainvestors.club where today we will be reviewing bwing BCCpay cryptic currency. What is BCCpay? BCCpay is a new website unveiled with a BitConnect team. The website explains how users can use the BitConnect debit card to load, transfer and spend several currencies for purchases and ATM withdrawals. BitConnect has hyped their BCC Debit Card for months and it's been listed as a major upcoming feature since BitConnect was launched. The Debit Card isn't scheduled to be released in the near future and registration for the Debit Card is scheduled to open at 9 a.m. December 1, 2017 however BCC Pay doesn't explain when the card is actually expected to launch. How does BCC Pay work? BCC Pay promises to make it easy to spend your cryptocurrency and you'll sign up for the bcc pay app then order a physical or virtual card through that app to use your card you'll need to deposit bitcoin or btc or bit connect or bcc into your account bcc pay claims that your wallet can be used to load your debit card for purchases in multiple fiat currencies, including USD, GBP and EUR. Once you've activated your card, you can use it for Online Purchases, ATM withdrawals and ordinary credit card payments, etc. The official BCCP website explains how you can use your Bitconnect debit card at 30-plus million ATMs and 35 PLUS million locations worldwide. Obviously, BCC PAY isn't the only debit card that lets you spend cryptocurrencies in the real world. Dozens of payment card providers have appeared over the last few years. However, we believe BCC PAY is the first card that lets you spend at Bitconnect and Obviously, since 95% of BITCONNECT trades takes place on a single, privately owned trading platform, many card issuers have steer clear of the controversial digital token. BCCPAY features and benefits Low Transaction Fees. BCCPAY claims to charge point twenty five percent fee when transferring money from bitconnect or bitcoin into fiat currencies the bccp website states that this is the only fee you'll pay to use your debit card more on that later second unlimited deposits and withdrawals most debit cards have limits due to KYC or AML verification, and the Bitconnect debit card website however claims, there are no limits on deposits and withdrawals of Bitcoin or Bitconnect from your BCCP wallet. Third, Multi currency support. Your debit card can support USDd gbp and euro and it appears you can use these currencies interchangeably although bcc pay is not totally clear on how that works they just say you can use these accounts to load your card anytime fourth virtual or plastic card virtual cards can be issued instantly while plastic cards can Fourth, Virtual and Plastic Card! Virtual cards can be issued instantly, while plastic cards can be shipped worldwide. And the BCCPAY website provides a full explanation of card limits. For more information, visit http://bccpay.com. Thanks for doing tuning in and be sure to join our alpha investor's email list alphainvestors.blog. Stay tuned for our next review.
